description: This is a PHP source file defining the Post model class within the Goteo blogging system. It includes methods for retrieving, listing, validating, and saving blog posts, as well as managing associated media, tags, comments, and related database interactions.

classes.name: Post
classes.description: Model class representing a blog post with methods for CRUD operations, retrieval by various filters, media management, comment and tag handling, and validation within the Goteo blogging system.

methods.name: sanitizeText
methods.description: Sanitizes text input by stripping disallowed HTML tags, allowing a predefined set of formatting tags.

methods.name: getBySlug
methods.description: Retrieves a post object based on its slug, falling back to ID if slug is numeric.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a post object based on its ID.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Fetches a post by ID or slug from the database, including related images, media, comments, and tags.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Returns a list of posts for a given blog, with optional limits and published status filtering.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves a filtered list of posts based on various criteria such as tags, section, author, and location within the project (e.g., home, footer). Supports counting and pagination.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates required fields (title, text, date) for a post, collecting errors if validation fails.

methods.name: slugExists
methods.description: Checks if a given slug already exists in the database, excluding the current post if editing.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the post to the database, handling slug generation, media and image uploads, tags, and updating related post counts.

methods.name: getLangFields
methods.description: Returns the list of translatable fields for multilingual support.

methods.name: allowed
methods.description: Determines whether comments are allowed on the post.

methods.name: numPosts
methods.description: Returns the number of posts associated with a project, updating project record if count has changed.

methods.name: getListSections
methods.description: Returns the list of blog sections from configuration.

methods.name: getSection
methods.description: Retrieves the description of a specific blog section.
